its airline subsidiary Mokulele Airlines was awarded a new $19.4M Essential Air Service contract by the U.S. Department of Transportation to continue scheduled service to Lanaʻi, Hawaiʻi.
The four-year contract, which runs through August 2030, doubles the term of Mokulele’s previous contract and provides $19.4M in government subsidies, excluding passenger fare revenue.
Under the new contract, Mokulele will operate 63 weekly round trips between Lanaʻi, Honolulu and Kahului/Maui, including 42 weekly round trips to Honolulu and 21 to Kahului.

title: Surf Air’s Mokulele wins $19.4M four-year Lanaʻi air service contract
